description: This file defines a Remix route component for creating new notes, including server-side loader and action functions, as well as a React component for rendering the form UI.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines metadata for the route, setting the page title.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches initial data for the route, returning default title and content.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submissions to create a new note and redirects to the note's page.

methods.name: NewNote
methods.description: React component rendering the form for creating a new note, including state management for submission status.
